# example Provider

Manages example items in a JSON file on disk. A real provider would point at a service here instead.

The provider has one resource and one data source, both named `example_item`.
The resource creates, updates, and deletes items; the data source reads one
back by name. The provider block takes the path to the store file and nothing
else — there are no credentials to configure.

`example_item` is a worked example meant to be replaced. Its schema, its
acceptance tests, and the reference pages generated from it are wired together
already, so swapping in a real resource leaves the rest of the repository in
place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    example = {
      source = "meigma/example"
    }
  }
}

provider "example" {
  # Where the items are kept. May also be set with the EXAMPLE_STORE_PATH
  # environment variable. The file and its parent directory are created on the
  # first write.
  store_path = "/var/lib/example/items.json"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `store_path` (String) Path to the JSON file the items are kept in. May also be set with the `EXAMPLE_STORE_PATH` environment variable. The file and its parent directory are created on first write.
